featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.

featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

today.name: Nexon Logistics November Convoy #86
today.description:
![](https://cdn.nexonlogistics.com/images/events/banner/november.png)
Nexon Logistics proudly invites you to join us for our November Convoy, where the roads of Euro Truck Simulator 2 lead us through the breathtaking landscapes of the Nordic Horizons and Scandinavia DLCs.

Our journey begins in Ålesund, a beautiful coastal city surrounded by towering mountains and deep fjords. As engines roar to life, we set out along the E136, heading inland through some of the most scenic roads the Nordic region has to offer.

The convoy will continue through Dombås, Lillehammer, and Hamar, following the iconic E6 corridor. Along the way, drivers will experience winding mountain roads, dense forests, sparkling lakes, and the peaceful atmosphere that makes Scandinavian trucking so enjoyable.

Leaving Hamar behind, we take Route 25 and later join the E45, venturing deeper into the heart of the Nordic wilderness. Endless forests, open landscapes, and picturesque views await as we make our way across the border towards Sweden.

Our destination is Östersund, a vibrant city nestled among the lakes and forests of northern Scandinavia. Here, our convoy will come to a close, marking the end of another memorable journey shared with friends, drivers, and the trucking community.

✨ From the fjords of Norway to the forests of Sweden — every kilometer brings a new adventure. ✨

Come along, share the road, and let's create another unforgettable chapter in our convoy adventures.

# Destiny Holidays Division — Event Rules

1. 🚛 **Follow Convoy Control** — All participants must follow instructions given by Convoy Control and event staff at all times.

2. 🛣️ **Maintain Safe Distance** — Keep a reasonable distance from the truck ahead and avoid unnecessary overtaking.

3. 🚦 **Follow Traffic Rules** — Respect traffic lights, road signs, speed limits, and right-of-way rules wherever applicable.

4. 🚫 **No Reckless Driving** — No ramming, blocking, brake-checking, racing, or intentional collisions.

5. 📻 **Follow Convoy Formation** — Stay in your assigned position and maintain the convoy order throughout the route.

6. 🔄 **No Unnecessary Overtaking** — Overtaking is only permitted when instructed by Convoy Control or when absolutely necessary.

7. 🎙️ **Keep Communications Clear** — Keep voice communications clear during the convoy and avoid unnecessary radio spam.

8. 🅿️ **Follow Parking Instructions** — Park only in designated areas and follow staff instructions during stops and at the destination.

9. 🤝 **Respect Everyone** — Treat all participants, staff, and other road users with respect and professionalism.

10. ⚠️ **Staff Decisions Are Final** — Event staff and Convoy Control have the final authority during the event. Please cooperate with their instructions.

**Have fun, drive safely, and make the Destiny Holidays Opening Convoy one to remember!** 🏖️🚛✨

### MORE THAN A DESTINATION – GEMEINSAM AUF ALLEN STRASSEN!

Die BESA LOGISTIC lädt alle Speditionen sowie freie Fahrerinnen und Fahrer herzlich zu unserem großen Geburtstags-Konvoi ein!

Gemeinsam möchten wir diesen besonderen Anlass feiern und einen unvergesslichen Abend auf den Straßen von Euro Truck Simulator 2 verbringen.

Freut euch auf eine wunderschöne Strecke, eine organisierte Kolonne und eine starke Gemeinschaft!

📆 Datum: Sonntag, 01. November 2026

🕢 Treffen: 16:30 Uhr

🚦 Abfahrt: 17:00 Uhr

📍 Start: München – BCP
